verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe autonomous multi-step research: forming hypotheses, gathering info, resolving contradictions, running for hours across thousands of cycles without further human input, producing a full structured report - directly matching the story. This is corroborated by beta-tester quotes praising depth beyond chat-based research tools, though all evidence is vendor-published/testimonial rather than independent hands-on verification. missing for 10: independent third-party evaluation or benchmark of the autonomous multi-step process, technical detail on how contradictions/hypotheses are actually verified
